title: Bluesky MC Plugin
description: A plugin linking Minecraft with Bluesky.
body:
# Bluesky MC Plugin

Logging into Bluesky within Minecraft!

## Installation

Stop your server with `/stop`

Place BlueskyPlugin-1.2.jar in the `/plugins/` folder

Restart the server.

## Login

Use this command (include the / at the start!):
```
/bsky login handle password
```

Your handle is the name after @ (e.g. user.bsky.social).

## Post
```
/bsky post Your message here
```

## Timeline
```
/bsky tl
```

## Change Language (v1.2+)
```
/bsky lang english
```

```
/bsky lang japanese
```

## Logout
```
/bsky logout
```
